title: Microsoft releases Windows 11 OOB hotpatch to fix RRAS RCE flaw
summary: Microsoft has released an out-of-band (OOB) update to fix a security vulnerabilities affecting Windows 11 Enterprise devices that receive hotpatch updates instead of the regular Patch Tuesday cumulative updates. [...]
